'''2005 U.S. National Championship Reid Smith DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2005 U.S. National Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by R. "Voice of Law" Smith (2005-07-06).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34965 Deez Nutz Scum]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071219214407/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34965 Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Reid Smith]]
